headline: Ghana's Valco Posts Positive EBITDA of $1.3 Million
summary: The Volta Aluminium Company Limited posted positive EBITDA of $1.3 million for the nine months ending September 2026, recovering from a $13.08 million loss the previous year.
why: State-backed industrial enterprise earnings reflect manufacturing and operational recovery within the regional economy.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Improved financial performance of key state enterprises contributes to domestic industrial stability.
